$comment: Catalogue of the skills Lavagna ships. Each entry points at a folder here containing a SKILL.md whose frontmatter carries name, description and metadata.version. `path` is a single folder name directly under skills/ — never an absolute path, never a path with `..` — and must equal `id`; consumers read either field, so both are kept deliberately. Validated by scripts/check-skills.mjs. The .vsix bundles this folder and the extension's Skills panel installs from it; the plugin/marketplace manifests read it too.

skills.title: Lavagna boards
skills.summary: Treat a .lavagna.md board as the shared working surface: answer in chat and rewrite the board as the living plan.

skills.title: Answer the spirals
skills.summary: Find every ꩜ marker on a board and write the answer in its place, reading the surrounding section and referenced files first.

skills.title: Execute a board
skills.summary: Implement a board as the spec: work through its checklist, tick items as they land, and raise a decision spiral when the code contradicts the plan.
